purpose: Unify the remaining public Trust, Privacy, Login and Register surfaces with the canonical public shell and source-native RU/EN/ZH presentation, remove visitor-facing readiness/status/connection-state marketing, preserve truthful source/basis boundaries, and leave every registration, authentication, authorization, legal, consent and database authority unchanged.
effectiveAfter: This implementation scope becomes effective only after its governance manifest is independently reviewed and merged. The implementation branch must then be created or rematerialized from the current exact main after the preceding public phases; no implementation may be merged from the governance branch or from a stale base.
requiredInvariants: Only the explicitly listed public presentation, localization, CSS, acceptance and scope-manifest paths may change. Registration/authentication endpoints, form clients, role assignment, tenant derivation, reviewer authority, protected cabinets, API contracts, database schema, release workflows and production topology are unchanged.

The canonical PublicSiteHeader is the shared visual shell for Trust, Privacy, public Login and public Register. This is presentation authority only and confers no registration, authentication, role, tenant or access authority.

The public Register page may change only chrome, navigation, locale continuity and responsive presentation. Existing verify and statusToken parsing, 512-character bounds, preservation across locale changes, RegisterFormClientPublic props and registration form behavior remain semantically identical. RegisterFormClient.tsx and RegisterFormClientPublic.tsx are outside this scope and byte-bound.

The public Login page may change only shell navigation, locale-preserving public destinations and presentation. LoginFormClient and authentication/session behavior are outside this scope and byte-bound.

Privacy policy legal meaning is preserved: data categories, purposes, access limitation, retention/deletion, external-recipient basis, data-subject rights and the prohibition on fabricated operator requisites may be translated and reorganized for source-native RU/EN/ZH presentation but not weakened or materially redefined.
No Terms, consent-policy source, consent version, consent hash, registration/invitation client consent metadata or PostgreSQL consent-evidence whitelist changes are authorized by this scope.

Privacy public navigation must not advertise protected profile/auth surfaces or a public status/readiness page. Public links may point only to appropriate public destinations such as About, Trust, Contact, Terms, Login and Register while protected routes remain protected.

Trust retains and strengthens the existing no-fabrication, authority, evidence, role-isolation, external-source and Gekta boundaries. Visitor copy must describe source, basis, authority, action and evidence rather than live/active/connected/verified/pending/ready/synced/maturity or similar public state marketing.

External systems, banks, government systems, EDI, laboratories, providers, partners, certifications, SLA, geography, scale, customers and economic effects are never claimed without their own authoritative evidence. Platform capability is not evidence that an external system performed an action.

RU, EN and ZH are source-native on all four public surfaces. The active locale is preserved through public navigation and Login/Register actions. Registration locale changes preserve verify and statusToken query values exactly as today.

Mobile is accepted separately rather than as a compressed desktop layout. At 320, 375, 390, 430, 768, 1280 and 1440 CSS pixels there is no horizontal clipping or hidden overflow, the full brand remains legible where the canonical header requires it, and interactive controls remain at least 44 CSS pixels in the applicable touch dimension.

Keyboard navigation, focus visibility, skip links, reduced-motion behavior where present, forced-colour resilience and semantic heading/landmark order are preserved or strengthened; no accessibility assertion may be weakened merely to pass.
No new recurring cost is introduced and production remains REG.RU-only. No REG.RU deployment or immutable release action is authorized by this implementation scope.

Every implementation exact head requires terminal substantive CI, genuine independent exact-head review, no unresolved current review threads, final base/head drift verification and SHA-bound merge discipline before merge. Owner self-audit and machine analyzers do not substitute for independent review.
acceptance: Autopilot scope guard accepts exactly the declared files and rejects changes to registration clients, auth authority, APIs, DB, consent authority, release workflows or protected cabinets.
Trust, Privacy, Login and Register render the canonical public shell with locale-safe RU/EN/ZH navigation and no visitor-facing readiness/status/connection-state marketing.
Register preserves verify and statusToken query values across locale navigation and still delegates unchanged registration behavior to RegisterFormClientPublic.
Login preserves the active locale on public return/navigation while LoginFormClient behavior remains unchanged.
Privacy contains no fabricated operator requisites, no invented personal records, no link marketed as system status, and no public shortcut into protected profile/auth surfaces.
Trust preserves authority/evidence/Gekta/external-source boundaries while replacing availability/connection-status language with source/basis/evidence language in RU/EN/ZH.
Existing registration, legal/recovery, public-copy, trust, i18n-runtime, typography and root-entry unit suites pass without weakening protected registration/auth/consent assertions.
Production mobile and public-experience browser acceptance passes at 320, 375, 390, 430, 768, 1280 and 1440 with no overflow, adequate touch targets and source-native RU/EN/ZH copy.
Web build, security, Design System v8 browser/accessibility, substantive exact-head CI and all required repository gates pass before merge.
